threads.author: Caitlin Suh
threads.summary: A Capture Tech cannot see the accept/decline options on the CT job request form for JOBID6622735036817477854 (Somerled Designs), and hits the same dead end via Schedule in Airtable. Caitlin sees the options fine on her end.
threads.note: Caitlin confirmed the job was still In Progress when the tech tried, ruling out the Scheduled-status theory. COP-2046 is open with Ricardo to check the Jotform conditions against the duplicate Job Status spellings (In Progress vs In-Progress) and fix record 93496's blank CT URL.

threads.author: Stephenie Yong
threads.summary: The Livit confirmation email renders dates as month/day/year instead of the international day/month/year, and preferred scan time is not a required field on the Livit Jotform, so confirmations show 12am when the agent submits a date only.
threads.note: Both issues are logged on COP-2019 with JOBID6613077533619588764 as the example. The open decision — patch the legacy Livit form now or fold it into the migration — is ours; Stephenie is manually amending confirmed jobs meanwhile.
